ui.intro_sub: Vector-9. 14:00–22:00. Eight hours you can rewrite.
ui.intro_text: You are an operative of the Correction Bureau. On your wrist: the Window — a closed interval of time you can jump back and forth through. The world runs by its own rules and reaches 22:00 without you, when Viktor Lash launches the Unified Grid. Every intervention changes the consequences — find the chain of actions for a perfect elimination. Only you remember: knowledge and one item carried through a jump.
ui.controls: WASD move · Shift run · Space jump · mouse look · E/F/G/H/J actions · Q time Window · T taxi · V get in a car · U use item · Tab log · N map · 1–5 speed · LMB shoot (pistol/rifle) · Esc menu
ui.window_help: Click/drag the bar to pick a time · ←/→ ±1 min · Shift ±10 min · Enter jump · Q close. Back: the world and you rewind to that moment; you keep knowledge and one item.
ui.key_hint: Q Window · T taxi · V car · K skills · LMB shoot · Tab log · N map · Esc
ui.result_hint: Open the Window (Q) and go back — or restart from point 0.
ui.pick_help: 1–9 choose · Esc cancel. The ride takes game time.
ui.leads: Leads (what you know how to do)

idesc.stim: Run faster for 2 game minutes (use from inventory: U)
idesc.disguise: Police don't recognize you on arrival

ui.in_car: In the car: W/S throttle/brake, A/D steer, Shift nitro, Space handbrake, V exit

skill_desc.obs: notice details, see more in conversations

ui.refuse: "I'm not talking to you. Get lost."

news.traffic_ok: Tram #7 and traffic lights running normally
news.traffic_dead: Traffic lights are down, patrols direct junctions
news.docs: Reporter shows Helion documents on the tower hall screen
news.postponed: 'Unified Grid' launch postponed over unstable tower power
news.breaking_lash: BREAKING: Helion chief Viktor Lash found dead
news.lost_pass: Noodle-24 market: kids lose tram passes, couriers rush
news.kay_dispersed: Patrol disperses reporter at Helion Tower

lea.k1: A girl of about nine pats her jacket pockets. Her lips tremble, hood askew.
lea.k2: My tram pass… The courier crashed into me and everything spilled. I picked it all up, but the pass is gone.
lea.k5: [Logic] Without the pass you walk. Is it far?
lea.k6: Really? It's yellow, with a cat in headphones. If you find it — I'll be at school until ten past five.
lea.k7: Dad forgot his badge at home again. He's new at the substation. Without it he gets told off.
lea.k8: For her it's life and death. For her father too — he just doesn't know it yet.
lea.k10: School → Industrial Zone: thirty minutes on foot. Tram #7 is twice as fast. The difference decides who will still be on shift when she arrives.
lea.k11: Something about time and distance slips away. Too much market noise.
lea.k12: Mom says I mustn't talk to strangers. Especially ones whose arm glows.
lea.k14: Pike. He's at the Helion-4 substation. He's nice, he's just always nervous.
lea.k15: Dad says I can't walk around here. But it hums so nicely.
lea.k16: She's a metre from the console. Her father keeps glancing from her to the red switch.
lea.k162: Uncle Yan is writing a paper about me. Did I do something wrong?
lea.k214: I'm not supposed to take things from strangers… but Yuna makes the best noodles. Thank you!

pike.k17: The rookie wipes his palms on his overalls and keeps glancing at the console.
pike.k18: Who are you? This is a restricted site, you can't be here.
pike.k21: Is your daughter bringing the badge?
pike.k22: An inspection… Fine. I do everything by the book. The dispatcher calls — I comply. Maintenance at six, by the book too.
pike.k23: He'll follow any order that comes 'from the dispatcher'.
pike.k24: You came on too strong. He backed towards the console. His hand rests next to the red switch.
pike.k25: Emergency cut-off. The whole district in one motion: clinic, traffic lights, tower, depot. Yan says don't even look at it.
pike.k26: He looks. All the time. Like at a cliff edge.
pike.k27: Lea? I forgot the badge… She'll bring it after school. As long as she makes it before Yan's shift ends — otherwise he files an incident by the book and we're all stuck here.
pike.k28: I… I didn't mean to. They were standing there, two of them, staring. And Lea. And my hand just…
pike.k29: He hasn't grasped yet how many people are in the dark because of one motion.
pike.k170: The dispatcher told me to shut the tunnel ventilation. I… I did. That is by the book, right?
pike.k199: Third week. Before that I assembled drones at a plant, until Helion bought the plant. They buy everything. Even me, it seems.
pike.k200: He's lonely. His daughter is the only thing keeping him upright.

yan.k30: Shift till half five, then the bar. Rules are rules.
yan.k31: What happens if a child turns up on site?
yan.k33: [Perception] The feeder chart in the locker?
yan.k34: An incident. Forty minutes of paperwork, and I'm stuck here even if the sky falls. A child on site is no joke.
yan.k35: Keep it down. I do. If I'm late — he sends his boys. To my work. He always sends them to work, so everyone sees.
yan.k37: The chart in the locker is outdated. The clinic is on feeder three now, traffic lights on five, tunnel ventilation on one. I know it by heart.
yan.k158: A child on site. Forty minutes of paperwork. Mok will kill me.
yan.k159: Yan will be late to the bar. Mok waits exactly half an hour.

mok.k38: A heavy man in a velvet jacket. His rings have chip sockets.
mok.k39: Sit. Debts are friendship you can measure.
mok.k42: I need a rare memory chip.
mok.k43: Dana Korf is going to stiff you.
mok.k44: Half the district. Yan from the substation — due ten to six today, and he'd better not be late. Dana Korf from Helion, so very important. You — not yet.
mok.k45: Shelves vanish into the dark. Implants in tagged bags. Memory chips — thousands, labelled with names.
mok.k46: A chip of someone's memories costs more than an arm. You can regrow an arm.
mok.k47: Rare? My supplier brings them by twenty past eight. Before that — only junk.
mok.k48: At 20:20 the chip hits the shelf. Nisa needs it earlier. The Window knows a way.
mok.k49: …Is that so. Interesting. At nine I'll give her a call — let her sweat in front of her boys.
mok.k157: Yan thinks regulations will save him. My boys are already on their way to his work.
mok.k196: Bring me old implants — I pay. Gold chips — I pay more. Wallets… people bring wallets too. The city is generous if you don't ask questions.
mok.k197: Scrap, data shards and wallets lie around the depot, the tunnel, the taxi stand. The pawnshop and Implants 24/7 buy them.

ro.k50: What will it be? Synthetic or real pain?
ro.k54: Rumors cost favors. Fine, first one's free: Dana Korf from Helion security owes Mok. And Mok loves to call at the worst moment.
ro.k55: Coughing. Third week. If she gets worse — I close the bar, and Mok can find another office.
ro.k56: He's grateful you asked. Something shifts between you.
ro.k57: Hart runs the bridge cameras. No deal with him, he's married to the monitors. Cameras go dark — instant alarm. You can only… switch him off. And loop the cameras.
ro.k174: What do people say about the Unified Grid launch?
ro.k175: Mok holds this bar like a dog on a chain: feeds it and never lets go. Half my customers owe him. The other half will.
ro.k176: Ro isn't afraid of Mok. He's tired of him.
ro.k178: Then another Mok would come. That's how the city works: debts never vanish, only the people you owe change.
ro.k179: They say after 22:00 implants will listen to one grid. My wife says it is like a shared dream. I say it is like a shared leash.
ro.k180: You have heard this line before. In another branch it was not Ro who said it.

nisa.k58: A stall of wires, eyes with a silver rim. Her fingers never stop moving.
nisa.k63: A forged 'dispatcher' call to any console. A loop chip for cameras. A device for an armored car's service port.
nisa.k64: I schedule calls. The tunnel ventilation, for example, can be shut off at 20:15 by the hands of one nervous rookie.
nisa.k65: A rare chip from Mok's pawnshop. Not money — memory. And I need the deal before 20:15, or I can't set up the tunnel call.
nisa.k66: Nice one. Someone's childhood, I think. Deal.
nisa.k67: Loop and device are ready. Calls by word. What do you need?
nisa.k73: The bridge cameras will show yesterday's rain. Plug it in before Hart sees an empty chair. And don't leave him in plain sight.
nisa.k182: [Memory] Do you know what the Window is?
nisa.k183: I was an engineer on Helion's test loop. Until I saw what we were testing. Now I sell other people's memories so I don't have to sell mine.
nisa.k184: You're asking questions you can't afford.
nisa.k185: …The device on your arm. I've seen the blueprints. Helion's loop and your Window are the same technology. You jump through time; they want everyone to jump on one command.
nisa.k186: The Employer never told you this.

osip.k74: Don't get in the way. I've got a car to look after.
osip.k77: Who replaces you if something happens?
osip.k78: Stable. As long as the current is even. Helion pays for her loop, so I drive for Lash. That's all my loyalty is.
osip.k79: If anything happens to Mara — he won't leave her side. Not for any money.
osip.k81: Armor, full drive. And an 'emergency evacuation' protocol: on collision threat it opens the passenger door. Engineers' idiocy. I inspect it at 19:05, every day.
osip.k82: Plug something into the port before 19:05 — he'll find it. After — he won't.
osip.k84: Feld. A pedant. By protocol he won't stop on the bridge for a second, even with a tram in the way.
osip.k152: I won't leave her. Let Feld drive Lash — he has a protocol, I have a wife.
osip.k153: His world has shrunk to one ward. The convoy will drive differently tonight.
osip.k191: What will you do if Mara gets worse?
osip.k193: I'll stay with her. Let them fire me. Let Lash ride with Feld — he won't stop even if the bridge collapses.
osip.k194: Dana decides at half eight. If the tunnel is closed and the bridge is normal — the bridge. There's always a tram in the way. I hate that bridge.

sol.k85: Visiting hours till eight. What do you want?
sol.k87: [Perception] What are those bands on the patients' wrists?
sol.k88: Stable while the power is even. The generator holds forty minutes. Beyond that — I promise nothing.
sol.k89: Helion's test loop. Everyone on this ward has one. Sometimes they say the same word in their sleep. At the same time.
sol.k90: You remember that word. You don't know from where.
sol.k163: The generator! Forty minutes, do you hear? Somebody find fuel!
sol.k164: Did you hear that? All of them at once. One word.
sol.k204: Helion. The whole ward is theirs. The patients signed a consent nobody read. I signed too — as the doctor.
sol.k205: He's ashamed. He's waiting for someone to stop it.

kay.k91: You're not Helion? Good. Here everyone is either Helion or owes them.
kay.k92: What do you have on them?
kay.k95: Documents on the test loop. The people in Heart-7 are test subjects. The Unified Grid will switch them all on at once. I need the hall screen in the tower. For one minute.
kay.k96: If there's no patrol at the entrance — I'm in. Bern stands there like a nail every evening from half seven. Unless the traffic lights die — then he's at the junction.
kay.k97: Half past three, at Yuna's. She's scared and brings blanks. While her office is empty — nobody guards the terminal.
kay.k154: They saw it. The whole hall saw it! Let them try switching on their grid now.
kay.k155: Bern again. Standing at the door as if he knew I was coming.
kay.k156: While the patrol holds the door, Kai stays outside. Bern needs a reason to leave.
kay.k187: I can help you get into the hall.
kay.k188: [Logic] Why the hall screen and not the net?
kay.k189: Really? Then get Bern away from the entrance. How is not my business. I'll be there from half past seven.
kay.k190: The net belongs to Helion. Anything I post disappears in a minute. The hall screen is a hundred pairs of eyes at the launch. People remember what they saw themselves.
kay.k261: Third day on my feet. Thanks for asking. Few people do.

ila.k101: Lash knows everything typed in the tower. Even my terminal password — the bay number of the first car back in the garage after seven. He thinks it's witty.
ila.k102: The password appears after 19:00. The terminal is unattended at 15:45. Impossible to connect without the Window.
ila.k103: Nothing. I'm not afraid of anything.
ila.k104: …He's good. Too good for this city. I can't give him the real documents.
ila.k167: He did it… Kai did it. Whoever you are — thank you.

dana.k109: At 20:30 I decide. Tunnel closed — the bridge, if the bridge is normal. Otherwise the tunnel.
dana.k110: You're asking the wrong questions to the wrong person.
dana.k111: Say that out loud again — and you'll learn how my security works.
dana.k112: The badge on her belt hangs too conveniently. She notices every glance at it. It's bait.
dana.k160: Not now! …Mok, I'll pay, you hear? Stay away from my people.
dana.k161: The second escort car turns around after her.
dana.k207: Brave. Stupid, but brave. The badge has a tracker, friend. A second after it is stolen all of security knows where you are.
dana.k208: One more word and you are in cuffs.

burn.k115: 19:20 — at the tower. 21:20 — escort on the bridge. Unless the traffic lights die — then I'm stuck at the junction.
burn.k169: No time! The junction is dead, the whole district is jammed!
burn.k276: So far. You're polite — that's rare. How can I help?

hart.k116: Hart doesn't look away from the monitors. Twelve squares of rain, twelve squares of bridge.
hart.k117: No deal with him. Only quietly. And the cameras must be looped first.
hart.k172: Hart's monitors show yesterday's rain. He doesn't notice the difference.

gas.k118: The bridge is under repair. Billboards, pillars, cameras. Everything is fragile.
gas.k121: The camera booth, Hart's there. Next to it — a billboard; you see the whole bridge from it. Nice spot if you're a photographer.
gas.k122: At eight. After me there's only Hart and the rain.
gas.k212: Hart? Doesn't sleep, doesn't eat, stares at monitors. They say he's implanted straight into the camera net. If the cameras blink — he raises the whole city.

yuna.k124: Seen a girl with a tram pass?
yuna.k125: Who meets here in the afternoon?
yuna.k126: Lea? My courier knocked her over at eight past two. He always flies like it raises his pay.
yuna.k127: Kai the reporter and a girl from the tower, at half past three. She always orders tea and never drinks it.
yuna.k202: Noodles with chili oil — and a Dash stim if you are running late. I have it all, come inside, under the sign.
yuna.k264: The courier spilled everything again, rain, Helion taxes… Fine. You're alright. Sit.

todd.k128: I play for the rain. The rain pays irregularly.
todd.k130: He touches the strings. The tune resembles something you heard in another branch. Or will hear.

courier.k133: Me? She did it herself! …Well, maybe I clipped her. Not on purpose.

vera.k134: Center-112. Every call goes through me.
vera.k135: How do you spot a false call?
vera.k136: A call comes in — I assign the nearest patrol. I verify later. When I have time. I never have time.
vera.k166: A call from the tunnel… Bern, check it. Yes, now. No, no time to verify.
vera.k210: Twelve hours, four patrols for the whole district, drones go to charge at eight. If anything happens between eight and half past — I'm blind.
vera.k270: Alone. Coffee and four patrols. At least someone noticed.
vera.k272: [Empathy] You alone for the whole district?

emil.k137: The 7th runs on schedule. As long as the part is in stock.
emil.k138: And if the part goes missing?
emil.k139: The next run from the depot stalls on the first incline. That's the bridge. Twenty minutes until the tow arrives.
emil.k168: Stalled on the incline, like I said. On the bridge. Twenty minutes.
emil.k273: The 7th is like an old dog. Creaks, but carries on. Yes, I love it.

lior.k140: The storeroom is the depot's memory.
lior.k143: Keys, tokens. Around 19:40 someone from Helion always loses something. Nobody notices until morning.
lior.k144: On the rack by the door. Without it the 7th stalls on the nearest incline.
lior.k267: Twenty years. I know every bolt by name. You're the first to get it.
lior.k269: [Empathy] The storeroom is your home, isn't it?

feld.k145: I'm the backup. By protocol, to the last full stop. No stops on bridges.

mara.k146: Mara sleeps. The monitors blink gently in time with something that isn't her heart.
mara.k171: The monitors flash red. Sol shouts something into the corridor. Osip holds her hand.

lash.k147: You were not supposed to get this close. Security is already watching.

ro_wife.k148: The woman coughs and pulls her blanket tighter.

collector1.k149: A silent man with a heavy stare. 'Mok sends his regards.'

collector2.k150: A silent man with a heavy stare. Scarred knuckles.

convoy.k151: The armored car is silent. Tinted windows.

bark.k215: Synthetic mango, freshest, straight off the printer!
bark.k216: Rain is bad for trade, good for umbrellas.
bark.k217: Two more ramen for table three!
bark.k219: They say implants sync at 22:00. What if my old ones can't handle it?
bark.k220: Where can you get decent coffee here?
bark.k221: Lash is at the launch in person today. Everyone's on edge.
bark.k224: The whole city will be here tonight.
bark.k225: Someone spilled coffee on the hall scanner again.
bark.k226: The rookie's twitching at the console again.
bark.k227: Overload the feeders and the whole downtown goes down.
bark.k228: The test-loop patients are restless today.
bark.k229: The generator is old. Forty minutes, no more.
bark.k230: Ward fourteen is talking in their sleep again.
bark.k231: Mok's angry today. Someone's late again.
bark.k233: Thirty-day pledge. Don't redeem it — the chip goes.
bark.k236: Children, don't run in the rain.
bark.k238: Yan will get drunk again — I'll drive him home.
bark.k239: They're checking the Omega twice today. Lash is riding.
bark.k240: Vera can't keep up with verifying calls again.
bark.k241: Don't touch pillar three — Hart and his cameras are there.
bark.k242: Without the part the 7th stops. Lior guards it like a child.
bark.k243: The Ring elevator is stuck again.
bark.k245: A coin for a song about rain?
bark.k246: I dreamed today already happened. Twice.
bark.k247: The tunnel is warm when the ventilation runs.
bark.k248: Mok sees everything. Mok remembers everything.
bark.k249: Drones charge at eight. Half an hour the city has no eyes.
bark.k251: The bridge has been under repair for a year.
bark.k252: Lights have been flickering since morning. Not a good sign.
bark.k253: Heard about the Unified Grid? They say things will get better.
bark.k254: Dark! The lights are dead, everything has stopped!
bark.k258: Acidic today. Can you feel it?
bark.k259: Hear the sirens? Something happened at the tower.
bark.k260: Strange… I feel I've seen you before. Here. Today.

employer.intro: Vector-9. Target — Viktor Lash: at 22:00 he launches the Unified Grid. The Window is open for eight hours. The task is impossible without jumps. Look around.
employer.pass: The Window logged a trifle: a girl dropped her tram pass. Is it a trifle?
employer.first_anomaly: The world changed because of you. Anomaly log — Tab: it shows what and why.
employer.first_jump: Jumping back erases everything you did afterwards. Only you remember — and one item in your hand.
employer.blackout: Downtown is dark. Not your target — yet you did it. Watch the clinic.
employer.time_low: Thirty minutes left. The Bureau does not forgive delays.
employer.win: Clean. The Bureau is pleased. The Window closes.
employer.echo_many: Strange: I dream of you trying this already. That line no longer exists, yet I remember it.
employer.alarm: Alarm. This branch is contaminated — go back and do it smarter.

signs.ads: UNIFIED GRID/launch tonight at 22:00|IMPLANTS ON CREDIT/0% first month|SLEEP 2.0/sleep less, live more|NOODLE-24/hot around the clock|HELION/energy you can trust|VECTOR-24/the news you deserve|MEMORY+/sell memories you don't need|RAIN/no problem — buy an umbrella

obj.look: Look around the market and talk to people (walk up and press E).
obj.pass: A girl dropped her tram pass. Pick it up (E) — or leave it.
obj.give: Give the pass back to Lea before 17:10 and watch what changes (Tab).
obj.jump: The world changed. Open the Window (Q), go back and try differently.
obj.learn: Learn Lash's evening: Ila, Kai, Osip, Ro, Nisa, Mok. Knowledge survives jumps.
obj.plan: You have leads (Tab → Leads). Build the chain towards 21:34 on the bridge.

tut.move: Walk: W A S D. Shift to run.
tut.look: Look around with the mouse (click the scene to capture the cursor).
tut.talk: Walk up to anyone and press E to talk.
tut.speed: Time flows on its own. Press 4 to speed up to x8 (1–5 set speed).
tut.pass: At 14:08 a girl at the market drops her tram pass (yellow diamond). Pick it up: E.
tut.log: Open the log: Tab. It holds the anomaly tree and your knowledge.
tut.window: Open the time Window: Q. Pick a moment on the bar.
tut.jump: Jump back (Enter or the button). The world and you rewind; knowledge stays.
tut.car: Walk up to a parked car and press V.
tut.trade: Find a shop (neon sign over the door) and press E to trade. Taxi: T.

story.nocar: No car — walks or takes the tram.
story.now_home: "My spouse is ill, I called the boss — staying home."
story.now_slack: "The boss isn't in. I'll grab a coffee while nobody's watching."
story.now_flee: "Shots back there! I'm going home, you run too!"
story.now_dark: "The lights are out, I'm going home. The kids are alone."
story.now_work: "Work, work. The shift is far from over."
